applicationPortal.value: Apply through Ball State Graduate Admissions for Music (MM) - Performance. The program page states that materials are uploaded in the Cardinal Landing Portal, including the School of Music supplemental form, interview scheduling/contact step, letter of intent, three recommendation letters, current resume or curriculum vitae, and audition/portfolio materials. Performance applicants may schedule an in-person audition in the portal on a main audition day, arrange an alternate date when needed, or upload a recorded audition as the portfolio.

sources.label: Ball State Music MM Performance Application

applicationFee.value: Graduate applications are $60 per program and the fee is nonrefundable. Ball State lists fee waivers for currently enrolled Ball State students or alumni, eligible current employees, veterans or active-duty military, guest students seeking transfer credits, and prospective students who attended a Ball State graduate program information session.

sources.label: Ball State Music MM Performance Application

auditionRequirements.value: Performance applicants must complete an audition for admission to the School of Music. For piano degree programs, Ball State strongly encourages a live audition but accepts recorded auditions. For on-campus auditions, applicants submit the completed School of Music application, including preferred audition date, by January 1. Video audition applicants select Recorded Audition in the application; faculty may follow up with a video interview. Applicants unable to attend published audition days may email musicaudition@bsu.edu about an ad hoc audition. For full graduate assistantship consideration, Ball State advises submitting the application and completing the audition by March 1.

repertoireRequirements.value: Final audition repertoire: Master of Music in Piano Performance requires a solo program of approximately 50 minutes in length with at least three contrasting styles represented. Final audition repertoire: Sight-reading is required. Final audition repertoire: Ball State strongly encourages a live audition for piano degree programs but accepts recorded auditions.

deadlines.value: Program application deadline for Music (MM) - Performance: February 1 to start in Fall; December 1 to start in Spring; for Summer, the application must be completed two weeks before the semester begins. On-campus School of Music audition scheduling deadline: January 1 for the completed School of Music application with preferred audition date. Listed on-campus audition dates: February 7, February 15, February 20, and February 21. Graduate assistantship full-consideration advisory date: submit the application and complete the audition by March 1. International applicants must submit all materials by the earliest applicable deadline, either the international deadline or the program deadline; Ball State lists international application deadlines as June 15 for Fall, November 15 for Spring, and March 15 for Summer.

Ball State International Steps to Admission

englishScores.value: Ball State requires applicants with an education history outside the U.S. to submit English proficiency unless they qualify for a waiver. Official scores must be sent electronically to Ball State Admissions; school code 1051 and admissions@bsu.edu are listed. Scores are valid for 24 months. Required English proficiency scores include TOEFL 79, IELTS Academic 6.5, Duolingo 110, Pearson PTE 53, SAT Critical Reading or Evidence-Based Reading and Writing 500, or ACT English 21. Ball State accepts TOEFL iBT MyBest scores. The Academic Bridge Program may be available at slightly lower scores: Duolingo 100 or 105, TOEFL 75-78, IELTS Academic 6.0, or Pearson PTE 51-52. Ball State notes that academic programs or departments may have different English proficiency requirements.
